messages:
Mira: Afternoon team  I dropped a compact draft of the product blog in the drive: https://drive.redwood.co/mini-launch. Need 10-min checks on: (1) benchmark language, (2) webinar CTA behavior, (3) who owns HubSpot routing. Trying to publish Thu 10am PT.

Sam: Quick look now. Can you paste the exact sentence with the number?

Mira: Subhead currently: "Engineers saw up to 2.5x lower token costs in our internal benchmarks."

Jon: Suggest soften to "up to 2.5x lower token cost in our internal tests" and add a parenthetical link to the methodology.

Tess: UX: primary CTA should be "Save my seat (webinar)" and fallback CTA "See technical notes". Add an anchor link to replay in the intro for readers who want on-demand. Mobile stack buttons.

Mira: noted. Who owns the HubSpot webhook config?

Sam: OpsBot owns webhook ops, HubSpot flows are managed by me for this campaign. Sam: I'll add three flows: attendees, registrants-no-show, and blog-only.

Sam: Pseudocode for the CTA payload I plan to attach to the button:

```
{ "utm_source": "blog", "utm_medium": "post", "utm_campaign": "product_launch_q2", "lead_tag": "launch_blog" }
// then route based on event: attend/register/click
```

Mira: perfect. Add a contact property set: lead_source=launch_blog.

Design: Hero image is ready (cdn://assets/launch/hero-alt.png). Please confirm size 1200x600.

Mira: confirmed. Design, can you also export a square variant for socials?

Design: will upload 1200x1200 by EOD.

Jon: @LegalBot quick check on the hedged benchmark phrase and a short disclaimer "results may vary by workload" please.

LegalBot: Automated review: hedged phrasing acceptable. Include methodology link and disclaimer. No named customer data.

Sam: Routing details: I'll implement webhook test now and post results.

OpsBot: Webhook test queued at 2026-06-04T16:15:00Z. I will reply with status here. :gear:

Mira: small copy nit: avoid "production-grade" in headline; use "production-ready" instead.

Jon: agree. Also move the numeric claim out of headline into subhead to avoid overclaiming.

OpsBot: Webhook test PASS at 2026-06-04T16:16:12Z  sample payload delivered to hubspot flow `product_launch_attendees`.

Mira: thanks everyone  I'm updating CMS with the revised subhead, CTAs, and methodology footnote. Final go/no-go ping will be here before 9am PT Thu.

Sam: I'll finish HubSpot wiring and tag the flows.

Design: uploaded square variant.

Jon: Final read done  looks good.

Mira: Great ship it pending legal doc signoff.

LegalBot: Signoff noted in doc.
